insurer: Cholamandalam MS General Insurance Company Limited

room_rent.note: Room Rent, Boarding, Nursing expenses up to 1% of Sum Insured per day; proportionate deductions apply if higher room taken

icu.note: ICU/ICCU charges up to 2% of Sum Insured per day

copayment.note: Mandatory 20% co-payment on every admissible claim; can be waived by paying additional optional premium

sub_limits.note: Cataract capped at ₹40,000 per eye per year; Modern treatments capped at 50% of Sum Insured; ambulance ₹2,000 per hospitalisation

initial_waiting.note: Except claims arising from accident; not applicable after 12 months continuous coverage

ped_waiting.note: 24 months for pre-existing disability; 36 months for all other pre-existing conditions except HIV/AIDS; HIV/AIDS PED covered from inception subject to policy terms

specific_disease_waiting.note: Applies to listed conditions including cataract, hernia, ENT disorders, calculi, varicose veins, etc.

maternity.note: Maternity expenses explicitly excluded under Exclusion Code Excl18; ectopic pregnancy is covered

cumulative_bonus.note: No cumulative/no-claim bonus mentioned in the policy wording

restoration.note: No restoration/reset benefit mentioned in the policy wording

pre_hosp.note: Pre-hospitalisation expenses for 30 days prior to admission; reimbursement basis only

post_hosp.note: Post-hospitalisation expenses for 60 days from discharge; reimbursement basis only

day_care.note: All day-care treatments covered; indicative list of 537 procedures provided in Annexure III

domiciliary.note: Domiciliary hospitalisation expenses explicitly excluded under Exclusion 26

ayush.note: Inpatient AYUSH treatment covered up to 100% of Sum Insured per policy year in recognised AYUSH hospitals/day care centres

organ_donor.note: Hospitalisation for donation of body organs by insured and related complications explicitly excluded

ambulance.note: Road ambulance reimbursement capped at ₹2,000 per hospitalisation

modern_treatments.note: Robotic surgery, stereotactic radiosurgery, oral chemotherapy, immunotherapy, deep brain stimulation etc. covered up to 50% of Sum Insured

consumables.note: Extensive list of non-payable consumables/non-medical items in Annexure II; no consumables cover rider available

global_cover.note: Any medical treatment taken outside India is explicitly excluded

moratorium.note: After 60 continuous months, claims cannot be contested except on grounds of established fraud

grace_period.note: 30 days grace for yearly/quarterly/half-yearly premium modes; 15 days for monthly mode

free_look.note: Applicable to new individual policies only; not applicable on renewals or porting/migration

portability.note: Portability allowed only to the same product with other insurers as per IRDAI guidelines; migration within Chola MS allowed only on product withdrawal

notable_exclusions.display: Overseas treatment, organ donor hospitalisation, domiciliary, ART for HIV, prosthetics/devices for disability, STDs, stem cell storage, OPD
